topic: API deployment and data dictionary issues
summary_markdown:
The session focused heavily on debugging deployment issues for an API reporting service (report-v3) and related data dictionary dependencies. Initial efforts involved fixing seven tables (`allunite.ooh_campaign`, `allunite.sdk_app`, etc.) to stabilize the system.

Multiple attempts were made to deploy the latest version of the Lambda function, which repeatedly failed or rolled back to an older version, suggesting a dependency on data dictionaries (e.g., `partner_company`). The failure was traced to issues with API Gateway keys during deployment, requiring changes in `serverless.yml` to use stage-specific variables (`${opt:stage}-api-reporting`).

A separate issue regarding the `boxdataapi` was noted, showing recurring 503 errors at regular intervals (approximately every hour), which was suspected to be related to underlying infrastructure instability rather than recent code changes.
decisions: The API reporting service deployment process was stabilized by updating `serverless.yml` to use stage-specific API keys.
It was decided not to reintroduce the `partner_company` data dictionary immediately, but to test it later.
action_items: Investigate the recurring 503 errors for the boxdataapi, as this issue appears unrelated to recent code changes.
Test the functionality of the API reporting service after a period of time (later in the day).
